nile_tilapia.illustration_prompt: Create an EXPLORATORY anatomy concept sheet of 尼罗罗非鱼, Oreochromis niloticus. This is an AI illustration, not a real specimen photograph or scientific evidence. Three distinct evenly spaced panels on pure pale gray: LEFT a strict dorsal top head view including opercula and shoulder, CENTER a strict front head view, RIGHT a45degree head view. Use realistic neutral matte gray sculptural shading so transverse anatomy is visible; preserve species identity from attached game side reference but do NOT copy its narrow inferred 3D head shape or pixel texture. Body construction hypothesis for review: full fish length 40cm, trunk maximum LEFT-RIGHT width only 5.4cm, head width near eye plane about 4.9cm. These are scale ratios, not text to print. Anatomical constraint: Laterally compressed body; bony cranial top has rounded shoulders, lateral eyes, full cheeks/gill covers; a short blunt mouth, not a conical nose. Show forehead, lateral eyes, pre-eye cranial width, cheek, full opercular covers, upper and lower jaw as distinct integrated volumes. Do not taper the whole skull continuously to a needle. A small mouth must not collapse the pre-eye cranium. Use nearly closed natural mouth with a visible small slit; preserve upper/lower jaw mass. No tube lips, broad flat catfish head, beak, nose spike, cut-flat face or giant protruding eyes. Stop at shoulder; no need to show tail or extended fins. All three views must have the SAME head shape and mouth state. Do not print measurements, labels or fake scale bars; no text. High clarity form study, not an approved biological reconstruction.

cross_sections.definition: 2D pre-model contour design only. Width factors multiply W/2 at normalized height t, from ventral0 to dorsal1. Mirror sides assumed; no 3D mesh is generated.
cross_sections.basis: D-authored species-specific outline sketch; independent width and dorsal/ventral contour controls. Neither CT measurement nor approved reconstruction.
required_later_checks: Eye-level width separate from maximum head width
Cheek/opercular fullness
Real mouth aperture and upper/lower jaw volume
No flattening or needle/beak front
Whole-rim natural transition; no added point on a flat cap

grass_carp.illustration_prompt: Create an EXPLORATORY anatomy concept sheet of 草鱼, Ctenopharyngodon idella. This is an AI illustration, not a real specimen photograph or scientific evidence. Three distinct evenly spaced panels on pure pale gray: LEFT a strict dorsal top head view including opercula and shoulder, CENTER a strict front head view, RIGHT a45degree head view. Use realistic neutral matte gray sculptural shading so transverse anatomy is visible; preserve species identity from attached game side reference but do NOT copy its narrow inferred 3D head shape or pixel texture. Body construction hypothesis for review: full fish length 76cm, trunk maximum LEFT-RIGHT width only 10.0cm, head width near eye plane about 7.8cm. These are scale ratios, not text to print. Anatomical constraint: Elongate body with rounded anterior trunk, laterally compressed rear; broad blunt cranial head, smoothly arched terminal mouth, slightly overhanging upper jaw; no barbels or pointed beak. Show forehead, lateral eyes, pre-eye cranial width, cheek, full opercular covers, upper and lower jaw as distinct integrated volumes. Do not taper the whole skull continuously to a needle. A small mouth must not collapse the pre-eye cranium. Use nearly closed natural mouth with a visible small slit; preserve upper/lower jaw mass. No tube lips, broad flat catfish head, beak, nose spike, cut-flat face or giant protruding eyes. Stop at shoulder; no need to show tail or extended fins. All three views must have the SAME head shape and mouth state. Do not print measurements, labels or fake scale bars; no text. High clarity form study, not an approved biological reconstruction.

head_controls.all_values_grade: D-authored, full widths in cm, not a measurement of biological lips/eyes
head_controls.unknown_rule: Do not replace these null biological/optical controls with FishShapes jaw-joint width or generated-image pixels. Lip aperture must be proposed separately from a head envelope.

shape_constraints: Closed skin body except actual oral cavity
Independent upper/lower jaw, real oral opening, rounded integrated lip rim; no point appended to flat face
Keep pre-eye cranial mass independent of small mouth slit
Distinct forehead, eye plane, cheek, operculum, shoulder and trunk cross sections
Do not deform fins with body envelope; fin roots and motions require new validation after any future geometry change
Preserve source pixel-art lateral identity; AI gray concepts do not override it

illustration_result.review: operator viewed; illustration only; rejected as quantitative modeling authority
illustration_result.parameter_version: v0.1 prompt, before v1 numeric revisions; therefore not a drawing of final station table
defects: Lips and jaw folds exaggerated; gill-cover form only exploratory

grass_carp.landmark_review: Operator inspected current-side-reference-contact.png, same aspect ratio thumbnails; rough anterior eye/opercular registration only, not precise original-pixel annotation or biological measurement.

parameter_use: This is a complete experimental envelope proposal and evidence ledger, not a claim that all dimensions are measured. No final species profile or model acceptance; unresolved anatomical registration must be settled in a dedicated 2D cage review before mesh construction.
workflow: Confirm species, gameTL, life stage/sex when known
Collect same-species data and native definitions; record unknowns and rejected sources
Register mouth rim, pre-eye, eyes, operculum, shoulder, dorsal/anal origin and caudal base on current side reference; do not substitute uniform length fractions
Build independent 2D transverse cages for head/shoulder/trunk/tail, with confidence/source per control; review top/front/45degree and lateral identity
Use generated views only to propose or falsify shapes; record mismatched views, never average images into scientific data
Freeze reviewed cage/parameters before actual modeling. Pilot Nile tilapia only; other fish remain independent
Future modeling must satisfy budget preferred1500/hard2000 whole fish, mouth-first, all-fin/root/motion/body-integrity and final exported cold-read review; none performed/claimed this turn
priority_experiment: Nile tilapia: strongest plane-defined head/body measurement evidence; current total body width close to selected biological scenario, so test independent anterior volume instead of blanket widening.
